A term becomes a local orbital centre and can be decentered; manifold interpretation is not arbitrary.
A view flips; context then holds views together without claiming one final reading.
Here/there and changing play culminate in checkmate and another game.
Knowability of the unknown and unknowability of the known return as Known/Knower.
Knowing one and becoming no-one enact recognition.
Zero, One and All remain in one relational utterance.
Field/way, sealed/opening, wind and bird return Real as re-All.
Near/far, old/new and many/few change the seeking relation.
Humanised spirituality refuses institutions that devour the human.
Waking confronts tiredness and bullshit in the poem’s own voice.
Law, window, wind and pigeonhole test freedom’s relation to form.
Borders, defence and pretence disclose the cost of guarded identity.
P0: two roads of two; cancellation and 2+4 remain distinct.
P1: binary limitation returns to shared root and power.
P2: language fixes and frays; life releases its achieved form.
P3: one-and-done is answered by the retained relation of two Ones.
P4: the underlying One question exposes framing, cloud and humility with precision.
P5: God is context rather than an argumentative object.
Plain horror and love/fear retain the poem’s affective force.
Scratching is the itch: desire, capture, child/sin, healing and brothers remain in sequence.
Beyond consequence is not inconsequential: journey becomes residential.
The notion born of difference extends the companion consequence poem.
Infinite multiplied by infinitesimal returns to one sentence and sameness/difference.
Feeling is undergoing: sea, winds, captain’s boots, Venus/Sophia/Martian figures retain local poetic offices.
Surface/layers, shoe/sole and unreturn preserve the Blake-facing poetic turn.
Finite mind confronts source, law or archetypal totality; the divine-mind reading has its own register.
Disowned internal difference resists the ego’s completed self-model.
Another centre shares a world while exceeding one psyche’s production of it.
Denied uncertainty is projected into an externalised negative pole.
